text: Sound stopped working!!!. Don’t but this product. I am on my second Eufy. The first one I had, the sound would go off completely. I reached out to Eufy and they sent me another one. Now, on my second Eufy THE SAME THING IS HAPPENING. I woke up to my baby screaming in his room, I have no idea how long he was up. & honestly it’s very traumatizing as a mother. The cord to the camera also makes a ringing noise. With the 2nd baby on the way, I was going to purchase the 2nd camera but now would have to order a whole new monitor and 2 cameras so hesitant to commit with worries of another failure and double out of pocket loss

Fail. 1 month or use and the camera keeps shutting off. Not turning off in sleep mode, but just going black. Pressing down on the power button turns it back on for a minute- then goes black again. Meanwhile I have no idea what’s going on with my baby. This product is only causing stress

Monitor turns self off in the middle of the night. I’ve gone through two of these monitors and I’ve had the same issue with both. They randomly turn off during the night. My toddler was crying and we didn’t hear her because the monitor turned off! It has happened multiple times and I’m fed up. I expect a reliable monitor for the price I paid!

Sound cuts out all the time... not worth it. At first I was happy with this monitor, but then the sound started cutting out for no reason randomly. So in the middle of the night, the sound goes away and we can't hear our daughter if she wakes up. Completely useless at that point. I contacted the company and they said it was out of warranty and nothing they could do. Way to stand behind the quality of your product. I'd avoid this monitor and find another one

No alert to let me know we lost power. I recently bought the eufy Security SpaceView T8300 for our second child. We have an older monitor from a different brand for my older child. The camera and picture quality are great. When we lost power last night the older monitor (different brand) had an alarm to let us know the monitor was no longer connected. However, the eufy monitor we just bought made no alarm. If it wasn’t for the old monitor we could have gone hours not knowing we had lost power and didn’t have a functioning monitor. I can’t confidently use this eufy monitor anymore overnight even though it otherwise seems to be great

A few pros, so many cons.. I will start with the pros:
1. Love that I can view from anywhere
2. Love the moonlight feature

Cons:
1. For an almost $150 (when I bought it) I thought for sure we could use it for years, well unfortunately it has died after just over 2 years. Incredibly disappointed as our cheap $50 one still works🤦🏻‍♀️
2. Set up is slow and tedious, making traveling with this a huge annoyance.
3. It is huge, bulky, and the base comes detached so easily.
4. Getting a good angle with how it is attached to the base is nearly impossible.
5. The music is ungodly loud very randomly, which has woke my son up a few times. 😫

I will never recommend this nor will we be purchasing another one

Garbage. This monitor is hot garbage. Sure, when it works, the sound is good and the video is fine. The issue is that the sound will just turn off, mid nap or in the middle of the night. You’ll turn it on, you’ll have it set up, and an hour later you’ll think, “Wow! Not a peep!” Only to discover that the audio turned off and your kid is screaming bloody murder two floors away.

Furthermore. The camera design is absolutely stupid. We’ve tried to travel with the monitor a few times and it is virtually impossible to be able to actually see into a pack n play, since when the camera is standing upright the internal camera doesn’t rotate far enough down to see into the crib, and if you set it next to the pack n play the night vision just reflects off the sides. If you lay the camera sideways you have to prop and wedge it.

Lastly, you can’t rotate the image on the monitor. When we installed ours in our child’s (very tiny) bedroom, we had limited options but found a good spot. It gave us an upside down image that we could not rotate and ultimately had to find a different placement.

We will replace with an audio only and use this as a back up

Don’t buy- doesn’t work very long. I purchased this baby monitor a little over a year ago and since then have had to contact Eufy costumer service several times to send me new cameras and parent unit because they don’t work. The sound of my baby crying wouldn’t trigger the parent unit to alert me or wouldn’t let the sound come through. After trying multiple replacements I’ve just figured out this monitor doesn’t work…it doesn’t do what it’s supposed to…let you hear your baby when it cries. I don’t want to use it anymore for fear of my baby crying and me not hearing it because the parent unit next to me doesn’t work and allow the sound to come out. I’ve contacted Eufy costumer service and although they tried to be helpful they won’t refund me or give me an amazon credit because they said it’s beyond a year. But, a baby monitor should last more than one year. Very disappointment that they won’t make this right. Would strongly encourage you not to get this monitor

Used for 3 years with high hopes, but just can't recommend. [[VIDEOID:b8bb1c5519a33994ff65716e7405cc5f]] I would give this product one star, but am giving it an extra star for good customer service. I REALLY wanted to like this camera, and I will admit that it delivers functionality at the basic level- it has night vision and broadcasts an image to a monitor. But for the price it needs to be delivering at a higher level. Let me explain.

First of all, the build quality. The camera itself seems decent enough. Sturdy and able to rotate as advertised. The additional lens also gives a great wide view. However, the cable connection to the camera is incredibly flimsy and can easily pop out if it's even slightly touched. The monitor on the other hand, leaves a bit more to be desired. It has the "cheap made in China" feel to it, and the buttons are clunky and cheap. When moving the camera with the monitor, there's a significant delay to the button presses, and if you're just trying to move the camera a little, you can easily overshoot and spend a lot of time trying to time how long you hold a button down and let go before it registers the movement and overshoots what you're trying to see. The cable connection to the monitor is wildly ineffective. If I don't wrap the cable around the monitor and position it just so, the cable will pop out of the monitor. Sometimes it won't even charge when the cable is plugged in, as it's very loose inside. I ended up just setting the cable aside and using a USB cable for a different product, which fit just fine. I would also point out that the monitor that came with the product originally stopped working, but upon telling this to Eufy, they quickly sent me a replacement monitor free of charge. They also threw in a free crib mount when we first received the item too. As I said, their customer service is excellent, which is why I gave back a star.

The second piece of this I'd like to point out is the actual alert system. There are two kinds of alerts, one that will turn the camera on from sleep if noise is detected, and another that will play an alarm if noise is detected. I like their idea of having these two separate alarms so that you don't have to be woken up by an alarm and a baby screaming, but there IS an alarm just in case you sleep through the baby crying. The downside of this though, is that the sensors are incredibly inconsistent. The camera monitors the sound levels in the room (indicated by a speaker icon and 5 dots along the top), and then transmits the levels to the monitor, which then reacts according to the alarms and sensor levels you set. However, there were nights where our baby was crying, and you can see the the camera registers no sound at all, causing it to never turn on (see attached video). Other nights nothing would be happening, and a car driving by outside would set the alarm off. It feels like the solution here is for the sensor to be much more sensitive, so at least it will catch your baby crying. Anything higher than a level 1, and I might as well not have a baby monitor at all. So now we just leave the baby monitor plugged in and turned on all night, and lay it face down on the bedside table to block the light from the monitor. It gets the job done so we've just dealt with it, but overall I'm very disappointed with it and wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

TLDR: I used this monitor for 3 years. Camera build is good quality, monitor feels cheap. Cable connections to camera and monitor are loose and cables fall out easily. Camera is inconsistent in picking up baby cries and often doesn't work as intended. Eufy has great customer service, but this is a weak product. Cannot recommend

Sham. Someone at the New York Times is being paid by Eufy. My friends and I all got this cam at the recommendation of Wirecutter and we all hate it. Terrible video quality, clunky interface, poor design, and impossible to replace the monitor when it inevitably breaks after being dropped once. Buy Wyze instead. Also shame on you, NYT

Get something else. I really liked the monitor aspect of Eufy and that you can move it around. However there is no movement monitor. I tried to have the sound detection up to 4, but it would go off every few minutes since we have a white noise machine. I have the baby sound detection all the way up, but I can hear her crying from our room before the monitor ever sends an alert. Friends told us this was better than the one I wanted and I just wish I went with my gut. So I ordered the original one I wanted. Guess we will just have 2 now, since its to late to return this one. Don't bother saving money by getting this one, spend a little more to get something better

Power input is poorly constructed, so the plug isn’t a good fit, causing the camera to disconnect from the monitor intermittently and forcing the user to manually re-insert the plug, which is a really awful experience if you’re a parent of a newborn trying to get a few minutes of sleep. Wouldn’t recommend

Great When it Works. Really love the monitor, it has great picture and audio, is easy to change zoom levels, and has nice settings for monitoring. Only issue is that the audio just stops working sometimes. So the kid will wake up in the middle of the night crying and I have no clue until it gets loud enough that I hear it on my own. Clearly this is a pretty big issue when it fails at its primary purpose

Doesn't last and light faces baby. Good picture quality. Dumb light on the front of the camera's base. Way too bright to be shinning into a crib. No way of turning it off because it "illustrates that the camera is plugged in"...okay then why not put it on the back next to the plug instead of shinning at the sleeping kid?

ALSO, this is the third monitor we've had to replace in three years. The first two had issues with the volume buttons and this one only holds a charge for a few minutes... It's out of warranty from the original one and three years later I don't have the receipt, so as the rep said "sorry".

OH And, the camera makes a loud clicking noise you can hear from the other room when you power off the monitor...cool

Parents beware 🚫 NOT a baby monitor!!! 🚫. I don’t write reviews. But, this product needs one.
Parents, this is NOT a baby monitor. This monitor stays on at all times. You can turn the monitor picture off, but the sound stays on. So if you’re a parent desperate for sleep, this monitor will 100% keep you wide awake. All the time.
The monitor also doesn’t turn on for motion or sound. So, again, parents, if you are looking for a true baby monitor that will alert you to movement and/or sound, do not buy this product you will be immensely disappointed

Dangerous and poor overal quality!. I seriously loved this baby monitor so much! Enough to buy 2 of them however the bottom detached from the camera causing the camera to fall into the crib. Luckily they baby wasn’t in the crib at the time but the product quality is not good.  Before writing this review I noticed others have had the same issue with means this product is potentially very dangerous. The camera constantly comes unattached from the monitor showing no camera is found. One of my monitors sound doesn’t work either. Wanted to like it but disappointed. The picture quality is really lacking on this monitor and it gets really bad when you zoom. May end up returning

My husband set it up when my baby was getting ready to sleep in her crib. It was amazing. The picture quality is amazing, sound quality is great, and we felt comfortable putting our first born down.
We used it for naps only for a couple months, and then began using it for nighttime sleep about 3 weeks ago, and I woke up this morning to a black screen. It won't charge and won't even stay on when plugged in.
This is very frustrating, because we are unable to ensure our baby is okay and safe during the night tonight. Very expensive for how little time it worked

Camera is very good, story’s, music and the lights on the M8 (I have M7 & M8) very helpful to buy time, great for taking to kids too.

Bad:
Do not rely on the white noise, any disruption in internet and it stops working, I can’t believe they rely on internet for something so simple that needs to be reliable for 10-12 hours or your children are woken up. We had to buy separate devices for white noise after a few nights of woken children.
The temperature sensor is off by about 3 degrees also, I can live with that but for what they charge things should work

We can't hear our baby with the monitor, can't use the VOX mode to turn the audio feed on when she cries or use the noise alarm. Anything that uses the speaker on the parent unit is not usuable at all at this point.

Tried turning off the parent unit and turning back on. Tried using it while charging (in case it was somehow power related). Tried resetting the parent unit using the pinhole reset button. Nothing appears to fix the issue

I don’t get the hype. High wirecutter rating. Great Amazon reviews. In practice though? This monitor isn’t that great.

Range is surprisingly short. Couldn’t connect well between our bedroom and our nursery. Picture quality is fine, but other eufy cameras are much better. Last straw for me was when the monitor fell off of my couch onto the rug and the display started malfunctioning.

Replaced this $160 monitor with a $60 eufy security camera with better picture, syncs to my phone and has cry detection alerts. Oh and I can check on my kid from any range.

Pass on the baby taxed monitor

This is a huge problem because you might not noticed that it turned off completely and you can't hear your baby as they just cry and no one is listening anymore. To clarify - the screen didn’t just turn off, the entire unit was completely off so it was silent and dark.

Three Years of Use… Frequently Frustrating. I’ve lived with the Eufy monitor for about three years now and have gone through two of them. After this much time, I’ve gotten to know the monitor pretty well, and overall—I’m not a fan. Here are my top takeaways:

-This thing is FRAGILE. Like they’re constructing it out of bird bones. I’ve gone through two monitors because—as parents do—I keep the monitor on my nightstand overnight. And in the middle of the night, I’ve reached for a glass of water and bumped the monitor onto the floor. To be clear, it fell 2.5 feet, onto carpet, and it BROKE. The screen just ceased to work. This happened twice, but the second time, part of the screen still worked so I’m just living with it. Super annoying.
-Speaking of bird bones, the kickstand on the back is also a fragile joke and will break over time even with the most careful of handling.
-The camera—yes, in the baby’s room—sometimes sporadically makes horrible loud feedback sounds. It’s totally jarring and disruptive and wakes up the baby. I tried to get Eufy’s help with this, but I was outside the warranty timeframe, so they couldn’t do anything for me.
-Sometimes the camera just unpairs from the monitor for no good reason, and it takes an ungodly amount of time, pushing all of the reset buttons, resetting things to factory defaults over and over again until it decides to start working again. As I write this, my camera has decided to unpair from the monitor (again!) on the first night of my kid’s potty training. I just sat in her room in the dark for 20 minutes trying to get it to re-pair, but no dice. So we’ll see if she peed the bed in the morning because I can’t keep an eye on her overnight.

I wanted to love this monitor so much that I bought the dang thing twice. Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice… you know how that ends

Wanted to love. I loved this product at first. But after about a month, it stopped connecting to my baby’s room, which isn’t far from me at all. This is very frustrating considering I paid extra for a baby monitor because I trusted the eufy brand

Monitor only works in neighboring rooms and not through exterior walls. Husband bought this for our new baby. And at first we really liked it, but soon noticed it only works in neighboring rooms. Baby sleeps in the master and monitor can only connect to neighboring rooms: the living room/kitchen below and our offices upstairs. The monitor does not work in our downstairs guest room, which is just 3 walls and a floor away or in the dining room which is right next to the kitchen. It also does not work outside when we are standing directly below our master and baby sleeps along the wall. We can open the window and easily hear his sleep noises from below. Picture quality, night vision, and zoom are great, but we’d have definitely returned this if we could as we cannot access our full house while being able to keep an eye on our 1 month old. For $160 we definitely expected better. We were planning on purchasing additional cameras for baby’s downstairs sleep area (the wretched heat during the summer necessitates a second sleep area), but instead bought a VTech set which includes two cameras and a monitor, so far so good with that one

Disappointed. a monitor for longer (as most parents would) I would search elsewhere…

As other users noted, several features didn’t work well- temperature is inaccurate, night vision is poor quality, display and audio freezes, not many options for mounting, and a flimsy kickstand. These issues didn’t bother us much, so we stuck with the monitor for a year…but shortly after, is when the issues began.

Unfortunately, when propping the monitor up, the flimsy kickstand caused the monitor to fall and after one fall, the monitor display stopped working. We would like to examine the wires, but there is no way to open the monitor up without damaging it. Seems like the device was designed to last only a short life span- extremely disappointing as the device didn’t even last two years. Will continue to search for a higher quality, more durable monitor that is worth the investment

Last night the almost 3yr old woke up and needed to go to the bathroom. The volume had turned off and she had a rough night until my son woke up for work. He always checks on her before he leaves. She had soiled her bed, got up pulled her drawers out looking for dry clothes. When nobody came to her she had cried herself back to sleep. Fix the problem or recall the product

- The noise alarm will randomly go off when nothing is happening in our babies room. Very frustrating when you are trying to get much needed shut eye.
- We find it turned off sometimes in the night when we know it was left on, and plugged in.

A lot of people have complaints about its range, but we never had any issues with that. All that being said, it’s not worth it to me. For $150+ this thing should not have near as many problems.

False advertisement on features. After weeks of research on baby monitors, we settled on the iBaby as our baby monitor for our nursery. Unfortunately, this fell far short of our expectations – to the extent that we had to purchase a brand new monitor to use instead.

Pros:
1. Camera quality is pretty good. Picture is clear, and it works well in night mode. I also liked the ability to move the camera around to scan the room both side to side and up and down.
2. The ability to talk to others in the room via the Speak function.
And this is about where the pros ended.

Cons:
1. One of the main reasons we purchased was the advanced functionality of detecting air quality and CO2. Upon plugging in, air quality showed as “Bad” and CO2 showed as “Unhealthy.” This was obviously concerning, so I took it to different areas of the house where it continued to display this. Finally, I took outside and it still displayed as bad/unhealthy. Based on this, I assumed this functionality obviously was not working so I had to ignore it (which is still unnerving because it displays constantly on your monitor).
2. The motion and sound sensor system was way off. You allegedly have the ability to set the sensitivity of the motion and sound to have it go off more or less frequently based on your preference. However, this did not work as expected. We were getting alerts every minute or so for something as basic as a shadow appearing from the window because the sun went behind a cloud. Even went it was set to as low sensitivity as possible, we still got alerts. So we eventually turned off alerts altogether – again, not desirable because this is a key notification you want for your baby in the nursery!
3. The temperature and humidity levels were incorrect – we have a smart thermostat and the temperature and humidity displayed on the monitor did not match our thermostat at all.
4. The star and moon display from the monitor was grainy and definitely not worth paying extra money for.
5. The available songs, noises, and lullabies were also grainy and poor sound quality. We never ended up using it and instead used our phone because the sound was not great via the monitor.

Most disappointing was – after realizing the CO2 and air quality detectors were incorrect – I reached out to iBaby where they informed me via text message (when I called they did not answer, but they responded over text for some reason): “Due to regulations we were requested to remove this feature from the app. We apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused.” When I confirmed the features in question they referred to were the CO2 and air levels, they responded “That is correct. The system was not accurate enough. We had to remove it from the app.” However, if you look at their website, and the application, these features are still actively listed and being used! When I questioned why they were falsely advertising this, they had no response, and they refused to refund or exchange.

If I could do it over, I would never have considered this monitor between the broken and falsely advertised features, and the poor customer service. Please do your research and consider another monitor for your baby!

Screen battery died after a month and Temperature sensor is extremely incorrect. We bought this monitor after reading a lot of blogs and Amazon reviews, and felt it was a great value. Boy are we incorrect! We would have been better off buying a cheaper monitor than to buy this. The Screen's battery died after one month of use. The monitor became unusable.
The camera quality is really good, the night vision is really good and being able to move the camera from the screen is good and the good things end there.
Temperature sensor is OMG bad! It is consistently off 3-5 degrees the actual value! This sensor would show 74 and the actual temperature in the nursery would be 69 (measured by +/- 0.5F precision thermometer). We relied on this thermometer and dressed the baby accordingly and the baby would wake up all the time.
The battery of the screen is so bad, they claim 8-12 hours, we never really got over 4-5 hours. For something we use daily, throughout the day for naps, we would have loved it if it actually worked for as many hours as claimed.
The built in mic is useless, you say something into the mic and on the other side you would hear is imperceptible and broken. Tried using it twice and gave up!

Overall buy something cheaper if all you need is video. Buy something more expensive if you need all the features to be working as claimed by this monitor

(updated) DON'T BUY: Updated model doesn't wake up when the baby cries. UPDATE: Eufy has replaced my monitor and camera and we have the exact same problem as before. I used to absolutely love this camera, but the newer models are just not very good. Most of the positive reviews here are likely for the earlier manufacturing runs that had higher quality.

We're going to buy a different camera and you should too.

We had one of these for ~2 years until we broke the antenna off. The replacement we bought (which looks identical to the old one) has about 20 feet less range and...

It doesn't wake up when the baby cries! Sometimes the screen will wake up, but there's no audio. We have a noise machine so you should always be able to hear that but there is absolutely no noise even on max volume. You have to turn the screen all the way off and back on to hear the noise again.

So, it's still a great screen/camera but you absolutely cannot rely on this for the alert mode. You will not hear your child crying

Quality Control Issues. The first baby cam we bought died after a week or two. It stopped sending and receiving and the antenna felt pretty floppy so I'm assuming the connection broke. The replacement cam has been working fine for the past year but has recently failed as well. The screen no longer displays anything. The backlight still turns on and the microphone works, just no screen. It was never dropped or abused, it just stopped working.

The camera quality is pretty average in my opinion, nothing to write home about. When there's enough light available, the color camera isn't too bad, but as soon as the lights are out and the night vision kicks on there's a noticeable drop in picture quality. It's got all of the basic functionality you'd expect from a baby camera but nothing that really makes it stand apart from all of the other options. 3 stars for being exceptionally average, minus 1 star for the quality issues

Not good. Monitor going out after less than a year!. We started using this monitor less than a year ago and already the screen is starting to go out. The picture will disappear and lines will cover the screen then it will just turn itself off. So frustrating!

Also, if you have a house with a lot of natural light or plan to use the monitor while working in the yard, etc, the monitor is only good for sound. You cannot see a single thing on the screen when the sun is shining. Overall, I would not buy this monitor again. When it finally does go out I’ll be ordering a different brand.

Disappointed!

Terrible design for a camera. The base is not strong enough.. This camera is a sphere. The base is nothing but a disc with few tiny prongs that try to keep the ball from moving. If you have a toddler or dog that could possibly bump into the table/dresser it's on, it will roll off. When it crashes to the ground the camera will break. The design of this camera was not well thought out. The video quality is good. If your phone has a do not disturb function at night you have to turn it off.  The motion sensor/alert to your phone won't go off

Alarm feature does not work consistently. I used this product for several months. The video quality is great. The issue is that the alarm feature - a feature where the screen and sound turn on when the volume in the room reaches a certain volume - does not consistently work. I had several times where I heard my baby crying from other rooms in my house, but the monitor screen and sound was still off. I turned up the sensitivity and then the alarm would go off from us walking past the room, which is too sensitive. So now I have to keep the monitor screen and sound on 24/7 which keeps me awake at night and is not worth the cost of this monitor

So disappointed. We’ve been trying to make this monitor work for 3 months now and it is a constant disappointment. Beyond the random pixelization and green tinted glitches, the most frustrating this is that the notification settings do not work. We have tried it set on both the minimum duration and noise level notification settings and the monitor STILL will not go off alerting us that our baby is crying. We can hear her crying ourselves two rooms away but this monitor will not alert us - the primary function of a baby monitor. Cannot trust it and will be contacting Eufy for a refund

Great… When it works…. We wanted a monitor that did not use Wi-Fi for security purposes, and we thought this one fit the bill. We’ve been using it for 3 months now and find the picture and sound quality to be great. Unfortunately, it only works about 80% of the time. When you have a baby, you need to be able to trust that the monitor will alert you when baby wakes up, especially at night when you are asleep. This monitor seems to shut-off on its own when it loses connection. I have no idea why the monitor loses connection. Our room is about 12 feet from the baby’s room. We keep the antenna on the receiver up, but the monitor often loses connection for a few seconds before it reconnects. I realize now that, if it loses connection for too long, it shuts off all together. And, no, this is not a battery issue. This happens when the monitor is plugged in. The first time it happened, I thought I might have accidentally turned it off when I turned down the volume before I went to get out crying baby in the middle of the night. The second time I thought it was user error again. The third time, I KNEW I didn’t shut-off the monitor. I comforted my baby, put him back in bed, watched him on the monitor for a few minutes as I fell back to sleep. I woke up a full hour after our baby’s regular wake up time and thought he had slept in. I checked the monitor and it was off. I turned it back on to find my baby screaming in his bed. Who knows how long he was in there crying. So now we will be purchasing a new monitor because we cannot trust this monitor to alert us when our baby needs us
Keep looking. Quality is spared

Works great until it fails, which it has failed repeatedly. We picked this up a few months before we needed it, and when we started to use it, it worked great at first. The temperature seemed to be off a few degrees, but was close enough within range that we could get a sense of the temperature in the room. The picture quality is great, both in the light and in darkness. The sound is good, too.
However, we had some major issues. After a few months of use, the screen failed to show anything. The screen would be backlit as if it was on, but wouldn't show any images and we couldn't access any of the menu items. We requested a replacement, and to their credit, we received a new monitor without much hassle. Then, the product failed again. During the second failure, we were outside of the 1 year return window, based on the original purchase date. It is important to note that we picked this up 2 months before our baby was born, and didn't use it until she slept in her own room at about the 6 month mark. So, we had two product failures within a few months, and definitely didn't get a years worth. I wish we could get at least one year of operation with this without it failing, but that is not our luck. I'm sure others have had a 5 star experience, but ours has not been great

There are better baby monitors. Our old monitor had issues so I decided to give this one a try. It has some nice features.  For example, I liked the fact that the screen was 5 inches. I also like the fact that when the screen turns off, you can turn on a noise alert where the screen will turn on and you can see baby if they reach a certain noise level (you can choose 1-5). I like how the volume buttons were right on top and you didn’t have to go through the settings. What I don’t like is that when the screen turns off, you cant hear a single thing. This would not be bad if I didn’t have anxiety 24/7 🤣🤪  The delay is also pretty horrible. The camera will also make a click sound whenever it changed from night mode to daytime, even when the monitor is not on. It’s not a horrible monitor but I prefer others over this. If the monitor had the option of having the screen off but the sound on, I would have kept this monitor and loved every second of it but until then I will use a different monitor

Most important feature (audio) no longer works!. I'll start off by saying I liked this monitor when we first started using it. But lately, the audio will just turn off completely, often overnight. This morning I woke up to my baby crying for god knows how long! I really don't need all the bells and whistles--just simple audio at the very least. I'll sadly have to return this product because it's become a safety and wellbeing issue for us

There are better monitors.... UPDATE!!!
I thought maybe by contacting the Eufy company they would suggest a solution to the issue. A few people said they are more than willing to go above and beyond to correct an issue...WRONG!
They said it was out of warranty and had no suggestions on how to fix the issue OR why it was happening. The cord is the main issue. Very unhappy!

We bought this when it was on sale for our baby due in February. We just recently transferred him to his crib and set up the monitor. We have noticed a few issues:

3. When it changes from night vision to normal it makes this very noticeable 'click' sound and will wake up baby at nap times when the sunlight either comes into his room or goes away.

We will be getting a different monitor

Garbage. First of all it's impossible to get this thing to actually face your baby. It comes on this idiotic tray that is what supposed to sit on a table that is perfectly the right height facing the crib? Even then it doesn't look down on your baby's face.
The picture quality is total garbage. This would need to be 12 in away from your baby's face to see what's going on. The sound quality is terrible also.
This monitor was recommended to me and I have absolutely no idea why. Real garbage

Doesn’t last.. It just simply doesn’t last. 3 months after purchasing I had to get a replacement. I thought maybe it was just a fluke. The replacement was working good for about 8 months and then started having problems. The monitor has been making a ratting noise but there is no way to open it and see if anything os broken. Not what I was expecting. The product deception was promising but when we set it up we saw how poor the picture quality is during night time. We ended up with the infant optics pro and it’s great

Totally useless for two kids, probably one kid as well.. I'm not sure why this thing has such good reviews. It has a sleep mode, i.e. the screen goes black and the sound cuts out so you dont hear your kids sound machine, etc. while your child sleeps. It also makes sure you do not hear your kid CRYING. We got the second camera so we could have one in each child's bedroom. We had to select cycle through which switches cameras every thirty seconds, and is extremely disruptive. I would have thought it would switch so you could hear the other child. You can set an alert, which I couldn't figure out if it actually works if you arent cycling through cameras.  A huge waste of time trying to figure out how to get this thing to work

However, we have purchased FOUR of these systems over the past 2 years, and every single one of them stopped functioning after a few months. They simply stop working.

I was so excited about this baby monitor! However, it did not live up to the hype. We love the camera, night vision and sleekness.

BUT the screen randomly goes black every 2-3min or so and we have to press the circular button for it to come back on??? Will update my review after I contact someone about this issue to see if it can be fixed or if we just got a faulty monitor that needs to be replaced

We Hate It. We received this as a gift for our baby shower, and as this baby is our first, we had no clue if it was good or bad. At first, I was impressed by the features. You can talk to the baby via microphone, the camera rotates, and it plays music! Cool! Fast forward to after the baby is born and in practical use and...not so much.
1. The battery life is absolutely abysmal. It lasts maybe four hours at the most after being charged up all the way. It can ONLY be charged by the cable it comes with; if I plug any other adapter that's the same type/size, it charges so slowly as to be completely pointless. So this thing now lives on the charger when in active use except for four or so hours a day when it's completely full. This is not conducive to me cooking while the baby is napping or doing anything else in the house when she's in her room. At night, I was horrified to wake up and find that the stupid thing had DIED in the middle of the NIGHT, and my daughter had been in her room screaming for me (she's 3 months old) for God knows how long, because I couldn't rely on this camera. So we now have two baby monitors in our room, and this stupid thing must be plugged in all night long. Thank goodness she wasn't on her face or being stolen or something worse than being hungry.
2. It turns itself off CONSTANTLY. I presume this is to save it's nonexistent battery, but again, that's nonexistent so it's just annoying. If the baby moves or makes noise, yes, it flips back on. Slowly and with a loading icon as it reconnects to the camera.
3. It sometimes just stops playing sound. There is an option on the camera to turn off the alarm that sounds when the baby makes a noise over a certain level, and that needs to be on at all times or when it stops playing sound, again, you don't know if your baby needs you. Turning it off and back on helps with this, but that's pretty impossible to do WHEN YOU'RE SLEEPING.
4. The picture quality is meh. At night, it's really terrible, but during the day it's pretty grainy. The zoom makes it even worse.

I do not recommend this item. Perhaps mine is defective, but I don't think so. I think it's just a bad product

No range at all. I really wanted to like this baby monitor, but it has no range whatsoever. I can’t even walk to the end of the hall without the reception breaking up on monitor, let alone walking downstairs

Dark screen, poor range, random cut outs. I want to like this monitor. The screen is large and it is easy to use, but you can’t see it in a well lit room even with brightness at 100%. In addition, the battery has to be charged twice a day and the sound randomly stops working. Have to restart the unit. Just too many issues to recommend. Look elsewhere.

Updated. The plastic has started to crack on the back of the case. Unexpected and disappointing again

Expensive and low quality. I am not a fan of this product. The video quality is very low and grainy. The range is small so it is constantly getting disconnected and beeping in my two story house. The night vision isn’t good at all. The wallmount is easy to use and it doesn’t require wifi but that is about all this monitor has going for it. I bought a $40 Wyze cam instead and I check it from my phone, the quality is unbeatable, and you can record videos without a subscription. Going straight to the Wyze cam next time!

Picture quality gets worse over time. [[VIDEOID:65584b5f070c33cff3dad5650adfaca1]] After having this camera for only 5 months, the camera quality has diminished tremendously.... it's so blurry we can barely see our toddlers face. And when he moves it leaves motion streams. 🤦‍♀️
The sound has remained good and all the qualities of the camera and base are awesome! But what good is a camera if the picture is so bad? 🙁 In my opinion it's definitely not worth over $100

Good... Until It Breaks Shortly After.. I purchased this monitor 11/27/2019. I didn't start using it until some time in the spring of 2020 when I installed it in preparation for our baby. The monitor has great picture quality, and compared to our previous monitor (one of the more highly recommended ones on Amazon), it has clear night vision and sound.

However, the monitor started getting staticky at the start of January 2021. It's important to note that this happened on its own (no damage on my or my family's part since we use it only during our children's nap/sleep and keep it out of reach from them). I contacted Anker/Eufy on 1/16/2021. The company provided different troubleshooting tips, but nothing worked. Because I was out of my 12-month warranty window, but as a one-time courtesy, the company shipped a refurbished monitor to me, which I received early February (I didn't receive tracking info, so I don't have an exact date for that, but I do have email records to show this).

I started using the refurbished monitor, and it worked great! Fast forward to the end of June 2021/start of July 2021 the sound stopped working, and I also was unable to switch/shuffle through the different cameras that are set up. I contacted Anker/Eufy on July 4 and explained that I received this (refurbished) monitor about five months ago, and it already started malfunctioning. I was told that it could not be replaced because the replacement was a one-time courtesy; however, again, the monitor started doing this on its own, and it was only after less than five months that it started doing this. After doing a quick Google search to see if I could somehow troubleshoot/repair this on my own, it seems like this is a common issue that Eufy monitors have. While some people are able to resolve it, many people haven't been able to do so.

I'm not one to write negative reviews, but I want to write this to give a heads-up to other parents. The quality is so good, until it breaks... I just wish that Anker/Eufy provided a longer warranty or better solutions, especially since both the original and the replacement weren't used for very long until they broke. I'm extremely disappointed that Anker/Eufy is unwilling to replace this item, especially given the short time I used the original one as well as the replacement that they provided me

Over all do not recommend this camera definitely a safety issue

Scam Product. Long story short this camera is a piece of junk.  It lags majorly and the video is very low quality.  I had to return it.  Not worth it.  Also I first received 6 bottles of BBQ sauce as the first shipment … it was supposed to be delivered the next day… it was late and sauce…. Not even close to a baby monitor.  By the time I got the correct one in- it is junk.  This item is a major SCAM

Didn't even last a year. I purchased this camera last September of 2020. It was the number one camera recommended on several sites, including an Amazon top purchase.

The main purpose of this camera was to see my almost two year old daughter while she sleeps and naps. The night vision is the worst thing about this monitor. During the day or when the lights are on the picture quality is amazing, but parents are rarely using their baby monitors when it's bright.
Less then a year into owning this, the monitor can only receive a charge if the charging cable is in a specific position and you have to wiggle it and push it and manipulate it repeatedly to get it to stay in. Those of you that had one of the early iphones you know what I'm talking about.

I really wanted to love this camera and monitor system, as it had replaced a Motorola baby monitor that crapped out just shy of a year as well. I had another baby back in March and was going to purchase a separate eufy baby camera to sync up with this monitor but after the trouble I've had with this one I decided against it.

Back to searching for another monitor that will last more then a year

Loud clicking noise!!!. The monitor makes a clicking sound when you check the handheld! I keep wondering why my son starts looking around the room the second I turn the handheld on to check on him! Checking the Monitor Wakes Baby Up. I loved this monitor until I realized that every single time I check on my baby, it wakes her up. We would click the monitor screen on, and realize she would start moving every time.

The camera makes a very loud clicking sound when activated by the monitor. This one fault makes the camera unusable unless you just never click the monitor to check on baby.

Super disappointed (angle, sound, temperature, cable). UPDATE: it’s now just stopped working.

The sound sensor is either too sensitive or not sensitive enough, and the temperature is always WAY off, like wayyyyy off. The cable is ridiculously short, even my phone charger is longer.

Buy another monitor. This monitor is horrible. Save yourself the hassle and money and invest in another brand. The app is super glitchy does not connect to my husbands Samsung or my iPhone well. Said bad air quality, so then we bought an actual VOC reading device that said our air quality was absolutely fine and we had very low normal range vocs in the room. I was so stressed for no reason thanks to this stupid monitor. DO NOT BUY

Best features on the market. The customer support has been impeccable. Had issues with my first monitor and the replacement one with screen going black, battery not holding and signal loss after half a year or so. But Eufy went out of their way once the warranty was up to assist with issues. Have had my latest monitor for a few days and it really has all the features I’ve ever wanted in a baby monitoring system, which is why I’ve continued to return to them. I use it to watch over my 4 & 1.5 year old. I love the size of the screen. We get great signal coverage throughout our 2 story 2k sq ft house. The resolution is great and I couldn’t go without the pan and tilt feature after having it with these cameras. Thank you Eufy!

So frustrating. The picture quality can be blurry sometimes. Sometimes, the sound will just shut off and I have to completely reset the button (this makes me uneasy). The temperature gauge is all over the place

Would not recommend. Worst baby monitor of all time. The connection would randomly drop in the middle of the night causing it to make a really loud alerting sound. When I reached out to the company to ask how to disable that alert they said it’s not a function that can be disabled. For a product who’s entire customer base is sleep deprived it seems like they would make more of an effort to fix that flaw. I think this monitor woke me up more times in the last year then my child. To finish up this review our screen just stopped holding a charge so we reached out to the company asking them to replace it and they said since it’s been a year they can’t. So now we’re faced with either buying a new baby monitor for our one year old or paying 60 dollars to replace the screen of this one

First it was ok. Now - Unsatisfied.. This monitor is ok, but has to be in a very specific location to actually monitor the baby. It can’t just be in a corner near her crib. The limitation is in the cameras ability to rotate and move.

used and returned, then sent to me. Garbage picture. Not happy. The picture quality is the most important part, it was greyed out and pixilated. Everything else seems to work fine. I ordered a replacement. If that one is garbage too I will look elsewhere

This is loud and bright. If you are following Taking Cara Babies or any other sleep training that focuses on darkness, do not get this. Disappointed. Very dissatisfied with the poor visual quality of this camera in the dark. The screen is nice and big and I wanted it to work out but the screen is worthless when you cannot see the baby

Several issues with this baby monitor. I wanted to love this monitor and I did for about a month; however, have already had several issues with it.  First issue being the adapter came apart while plugged into the wall which I didn’t realize until I went to unplug another cord and was shocked. However, now the screen on the monitor is no longer working (waiting on a response from them). The sound still works on the monitor which is better than nothing.  This is both frustrating and disappointing!!

Good cameras, TERRIBLE monitor.. The cameras themselves and picture quality is acceptable but the monitor is terrible! We have to power it up twice in order to get it to turn on. Great in concept, but worthless in actual use. I wish I could recommend this monitor.  I own and love many other Eufy products. And in concept this is a great monitor at a good price point, but in execution it is to be avoided. The picture and sound are great, but the temperature reading is for amusement purposes only, as it frequently reads at a dangerously, but definitely inaccurate, high temperature.  I can disregard that the temperature reading is to be ignored, it wasn’t all that important to me after the first few months, but it’s the complete fragility of the monitor unit that is the issue. I’m not even to my sons second birthday and I’m already on the third monitor.  The first two, the antenna came loose and eventually broke off simply from routinely lifting and lowering of the antenna as intended (and to their, credit eufy was quick to send a replacement monitor, they really are a great customer-oriented company). I thought I got smart with monitor no. 3, as this time I taped the antenna down with masking tape and warned with a sharpie notation “DO NOT RAISE.”  Unfortunately, while that took the antenna issue out of play, the monitor just went dead a mere 6 months into its usage. The screen will turn a slightly lighter black, but that’s it. No picture, no sound. I wish I could give this item 5 stars, and when it worked it was great, but at this price there is really no excuse for a monitor not even making it to your child’s second birthday, never mind when you consider that in my case it was really THREE monitors that couldn’t make it two years

Poor quality - will not last. Worked great until it started failing in multiple ways... When we first started using it, it was great. I wish I could get a refund. Eufy - if you read this and can send a replacement I am happy to try another, maybe I got a lemon

Bad, sluggish interface and annoying echo. The interface for this thing is sluggish and confusing. It's packed with options, but I only ever want to toggle a few of them. Nevertheless I have to click through a ton of menus each time which is slow.

Horrible camera. This camera is terrible. The picture quality is so blurry I can’t even see the baby. I would like to return this camera

The good and the bad. The picture and video on the monitor or fine. The problem is the alarm system. Sometimes when a plane flies over the alarm goes off which wakes me and my wife up. No longer functional after one year. We read Wirecutter's review and decided to go with this monitor over one year ago. We thought baby monitor was adequate when we first got it. Camera sounds have terrified my toddler. This is our third camera. The one we had most recently was cheaper and the second camera never connected to the monitor. So, we thought it would be time to invest in a nicer camera to see if we could get better results.

I want to love this camera. The image is great. Being able to rotate the camera is great. Unfortunately, the sound quality is strange; The volume has to be nearly all the way up to hear what is my toddler is saying.

Want to like it, but I HATE it.. Man I want to love this monitor. Here are some pros:

2. It looks nice and feels like a quality product.

Cons:
1. The camera is LOUD when it’s working to focus. If my child is sleeping lightly, it wakes him up. This is BEYOND frustrating, especially when it ends bedtime or nap time early. We’ll be buying a different product for this reason alone because we simply cannot have the baby monitor ending nap times early or waking our toddler up early in the morning. It’s just not okay.

2. It has a very small range and constantly disconnects, which sends off an alarm and wakes us up. My cheap video monitor has a better range than this one. And waking up to a monitor beeping at me simply because it can’t find the camera is about as obnoxious as nap time ending early. Once the monitor is about 20 feet away from the room, it disconnects randomly and constantly. Seems like this is a crazy short range.

3. It will just decide on its own to flip to the other camera - we have dual cameras set up on this. So sometimes I won’t hear that my child is up, because it’s not on the correct camera. This really isn’t okay with me. If I wanted to see the other camera, I’d toggle it myself thank you.

I’d either save your money and get a cheaper product that will work just as well, if not better, or spend extra money and get a superior product that this camera is supposedly competing with. I wish we were inside the return window on this, but we’re not so we’ll just have to eat the cost and try to find something better

Decent but with a flaw that could be a deal-breaker for some. This baby monitor is almost very good but has a consistent problem where the VOX mode does not activate / alert when the baby is crying. Other than that, this monitor would easily be 4-stars and possibly 5.

Here is some more detail: VOX mode allows you to turn off the screen, and then the monitor will turn on when there is sound above a user-configured threshold. Eufy’s documentation says that the noise has to be for longer than a half-second to trigger, but we constantly have times where our baby cries and it doesn’t trigger. Sometimes it is very short — like just a single cry and then silence so in those cases I would accept Eufy’s explanation. But a lot of times the baby will be actively and continuously crying and the monitor will not come on. In fact, what prompted me to write this review is that my baby was crying for around 5 seconds and I could clearly hear him from the living room but the monitor didn’t come on.

Other than that I have no serious complaints

Has good features but am not impressed. I was excited to find a monitor with a big screen and the panoramic feature for this price. Good of you travel with kids, but durability leaves a lot on the table.. We mostly used this baby monitor at night since we are both working parents. The good things about this baby monitor is that it is very easy to setup which has been amazing to work with when traveling with an infant. To grandparents houses, vacations, or just setting up at home. The range is also really good. In fact it worked across 3 hotel rooms (my folks in law baby sat our son while we attended my cousins wedding at a hotel).

The annoying things are that Eufy has many firmware updates for this device, and with no wifi connection it requires manual intervention to update the firmware. But for some the disconnect from the internet could be a selling point!

The part that ultimately has provoked me.towrire a review was how easily the device became obsolete by a small drop from my 10mth old son on our kitchen floor. Now the monitors screen only shows a black image (clearly no feed to it), yet continues to give audio. So at best it is now a nighlight for when my son cries at night... But when his nursery is next door to our room that's not super helpful.

So I'm summary, if you like a tech savvy baby monitor this can fit the bill, it offers RF tech for the security minded, and when used in daylight (for naps) can give pretty good image quality. But be warned it cannot survive normal abuse from an Infant (let alone a toddler!). So if you travel a lot I would recommend this for easy setup, but it's durability and ability to be updated by the average Joe might make it a poor choait for the average consumer

Undependable!. I wanted to love this monitor bc we love the eufy brand, but just couldn't trust it to work accurately all the time and had to return it. Here's my experience:
I set it up at naptime and it worked great! Monitor turned off and on when he made noise, screen quality was great... No issues.
That same evening it was like a different monitor! Suddenly (without changing any thing in his room or on the monitor) the camera unit was reading my son's white noise machine as a level 3 on the noise scale. This caused the monitor to constantly turn on and off which also caused the camera unit to turn on and off in my son's room. When it does that, it makes a fairly loud clicking sound, which started waking up my son bc it was happening every 15-30 seconds. (Obviously his sound machine wasn't that loud.)
I adjusted the sensitivity level to volume 4 (one level up), and it stopped turning off and on constantly. However 30 mins later I heard my son SCREAMING in his room, and the monitor didn't turn on at all! We are on the other side of the house from my son's room, so for us to hear him he was REALLY loud and upset.
I don't understand what happened and why the monitor is so undependable, but since it doesn't have the option to leave the sound on when you put the screen in sleep mode, we returned it.

Reliable monitoring is the main point of these systems! You can have all the bells and whistles, amazing picture quality, or even HD sound... But if it doesn't reliably tell me when my child wakes up screaming, it's worthless!

I had to go into my sleeping baby’s room and connect it to my phone to fix it. It kept getting stuck and it took over an hour to fix. Same thing is happening today with not turning off.

Separately from all of that, don’t get sold on the music. It sounds like a great idea in theory, but in reality the music is hard to use and the sound quality is not good. I’m better off playing Spotify from an iPad in his room

Should be amazing with all the features it boasts.... I've had this monitor for almost a year. Didn't really use it for the first 4 or 5 months after my baby was born since he was in the master bedroom with us but had it set up the entire time. I'm using it now and there are several things that are annoying. • I feel like the camera quality has deteriorated. The picture seems fuzzy, especially the night vision and it's smoky around the edges.
• The camera has better range if you want to stare at the ceiling rather than watch your baby below. If you're mounting it to the wall, the base obstructs part of the view.
• If I try to speak through the monitor it gets feedback and loops noise.
• If you want to use the rotating nightlight the camera turns with it.
• When I try to play white noise it'll, sometimes, play music instead.
• The sensors are inaccurate.

Humming noise. The monitor makes a terrible humming noise. Immediate return. Very disappointed— seemed like it would be an improvement over the lower video quality of our current monitor. But it should work straight out of the box and this monitor did not

Will wake up your baby. Don't do it, you'll regret it.. As I write this my kid is screaming because I decided to check on him. That's because the eufy makes a loud click sound when it engages the infrared camera at night, and we only figure this out tonight. We're always wondering why every time we check the camera the baby seemed to be moving and it's because the camera wakes him up. so we did an experiment and sure enough there's a click. There are multiple people posting here and in the Eufy forums complaining about it. It's just not worth it -- for all of the convenience the camera offers, it wakes your kid up, so just don't bother

Expected better picture quality at this price point.. I like that it doesn’t need WiFi and has good battery life. Worked great for camping trips and such. Pan and tilt are good. Overall aesthetics are nice.

I don’t like the picture quality. I don’t need HD for a baby monitor but you can’t even tell if he has his binky in half the time. The colors are horrible. The company claims it’s from artificial light but with pure daylight the screen always looks purple. I mean I pretty much like everything about this camera except for the picture quality. If it had average picture quality I’d give it 4 stars. Good quality I’d give it 5. As is I’m giving it 2

Great picture quality when it works for the first 6 months. The good: awesome camera quality. No other baby monitor has picture quality like this. Awesome night vision and zoom function; you can literally see if your baby is breathing. The wide angle lens is a huge plus too, can see everything!
The bad: within the first week I started having connectivity issues. I would have to unplug and replay the monitor in the middle of the night because the sound would be working but the night vision wouldn’t be. I was told to get an update, but updating was very difficult because you have to go to a Dropbox and install everything yourself (and I have a work computer that doesn’t allow external hard drives for security reasons. Then I had a Mac that didn’t have a USB port... so it just created inconveniences). The connectivity was also going in and out every hour or so, and the range was pretty bad... couldn’t go across my house and I don’t live in a big house. Basically used it during the night on my bedside.
The ugly; the actual durability of the monitor is terrible. The antenna broke within a month and was hanging off within 3 months. The screen started to warp by 4 months. Had to buy another monitor because it was just so annoying with the connectivity glitches and monitor falling apart.
Conclusion: awesome picture quality when it works for the first 6 months. As a new mom, I was happy to see that during the scary parts of my newborns life I was able to monitor the thing I cared about (breathing) but as he got older I care more about durability and range... and this camera doesn’t have it

Highly do not recommend. I dislike so many aspects of this baby monitor.  The thing I most detest about it is that there is a BRIGHT green light on the back of the monitor (the power light).  In my baby's dark room at night that light is so bright it's pretty much a night light and the baby will stare at it, keeping him awake.  I have covered the light with tape but it's just annoying that a baby product would be created without thinking through something simple like a bright power light.  I dislike that every time I open the app I have to restart it in order to know that I'm seeing an accurate picture of my baby.  I dislike that the carbon monoxide detector and unnecessary "smell" detector are always so wrong.  Because these seem to be consistently arbitrary readings, it makes me not trust the temperature reading either.  I dislike that in general the stupid cylinder shape of the monitor makes it so hard to position in the room to get a truly great view of the crib.  I dislike that so many times I can't see if my baby's eyes are open or closed because the camera always gives such a bad view.  I dislike that the other "features" like the 2-way speaker and the light projection are such bad quality.  I have stuck it out using this monitor because it's the one thing my husband did the research on for our baby registry and I don't want to hurt his feelings by replacing it but most likely I will be taking advantage of Amazon's 1-year baby registry return policy.  Highly do not recommend this product

Bright camera light. Holy bright LED light! My daughter likes her room to be pitch black at night. The LED on the camera is so bright is cast a shadow of her crib onto the floor and lit up the entire ceiling corner where the camera was mounted. There is no way a child who likes a dark room will want this camera on them all night. It’s as bright as a full moon in there

DO NOT BUY THIS ITEM. I couldn't give a "0" star rating or I would have. In less than a year there was a short on the device that would not allow it to charge unless you moved the cord to a certain position and then you took chances not hearing your baby. I know caven turn it on. I called Samsung and had to wait in line with 15 other people before they got to my call. They told me they would have to charge me $45 to fix the device. In the middle of the conversation the phone hung up and I don't want to wait in line for 30 minutes again.  I previously posted the following review but had to come back and change it because i can't use the device anymore.  (I like everything about this camera except two things. The first one is the plug that goes into the wall to charge the device shorted out on me in about a year. I woke up one night with my baby screaming not knowing that the device had shut off because it had died. Very upset about this. Won’t charge and inaccurate temperatures. The picture quality and night vision on this camera are great. However, there are some major issues. The charger doesn’t work unless it is positioned just so, so the camera dies every night without warning despite our best efforts to make sure it’s at just the right angle prior to falling asleep. The thermometer/temperature on the camera is also completely inaccurate, and in the six months in which we have used it has only shown five temperatures (one of which is 134 degrees), sometimes jumping randomly between two completely different numbers (for example 77 and 134). The charger and the temperature gauge have remained consistent since purchase (neither has ever worked)

Not worth it. We bought this based off of some of the reviews and that we were willing to step up our game in the baby monitor department. This one cost more than double most of the previous options. It looks pretty and slick but it is not worth it.
1. There are blind spots in the camera view. The Camera can look directly below it so if the baby crawls directly below the camera you cannot see them. Or if you install the camera above Baby's bed then you cannot pan down to see the baby while he is in his crib. You have to put the camera across the room to see the bed and even then you cannot see up close because of point number 2.
2. The night vision is very grainy and not a clear picture. If you zoom in you can not see anything in the dark very clearly. It is fine when there is light on. Since you have to install it across the room you will not have the ability with this Cam to see your baby sleep, you can only get a general picture of movement in the bed.
3. The Music feature on this piece of technology is total crap. about 40-50% of the time the device will not connect and the music is buffering and nothing plays. I have had better production out of a 30$ piece of equipment then this device.

I really wish I had saved the money and gone back to get another device that would actually work

Not the best baby camera out there. We purchased this because we were moving to a country that doesn’t have a consistent internet connection and our CocoonCam requires Internet. We found it on WireCutter, which has been our Bible for all things baby and beyond. Unfortunately, this time it disappointed.

The pros: we love the picture quality, that it’s portable, the temperature display, and that we can remotely adjust the camera.

The cons: the battery life is horrendous. It lasts one night with bare minimum usage. Unless I am missing something, there is not a feature whereby it will only make noise when the baby is crying (it’s either all sounds or no sound). And finally, we didn’t really think about this, but our new house has concrete walls, so the signal cuts out from one side of our house to the other (and our house is not big!)

Luckily, our CocoonCam will be arriving in a couple weeks, and we will happily splurge on a better internet package for better sound alerts and hopefully a better connection. This will be a great travel camera, but I don’t see us using it nightly

Returned in 4 days.. I’ve had this monitor for 4 days and I am already having to return it. I’m starting to think the reviews shown are paid because this monitor does not work at all and for the price I paid it’s alarming. I have had to reset it over 6 times and now I am over it and returning. The song choices are not great, the white noise does not sound like white noise. Honestly you are better off buying a hatch sound machine and then a cheaper monitor. I also tested this monitor out and tried to check on my little one off site while at work on their Wifi  and it didn’t work. As a FYI my wi fi is fine, never had a problem, this monitor however is terrible. I would not recommend this to anyone

Love it, but MAJOR flaws make it unusable!. I’ll start by saying I loved this monitor when we got it. Easy setup, great picture quality, love the large screen. However, within two weeks of using it, the following experiences or lack of key features makes this unusable and quite frankly unsafe.

(1) The beautiful screen/picture quality matters not when the screen glitches out after two weeks (see picture).

(2) There is a constant static noise that comes from the monitor, even when there is no noise coming from the room with the camera. I’ve troubleshooted to no avail. It’s not picking up interferences as far as I can tell. Just constant static that you hear if you’re close to the monitor unit. Other reviewers said the same thing but I ignored it. Now I know what they’re talking about. It’s loud enough to keep me up at night if the monitor is on my nightstand by my bed. Obviously less than ideal.

(3) But the kicker is there is no low battery alert. THERE IS NO LOW BATTERY ALERT. Three times now in the middle of the night our monitor unit has died. No warning. No annoying beep to wake us up and plug it in. This is our lifeline to our newborn in her bedroom. Being summer, we have an air conditioner, fans, and a dehumidifier running, meaning it’s extra hard to hear noise from down the hall. This is the single feature that puts me over the edge.

There is so much I want to love about the eufy spaceview baby monitor, but three major flaws and I simply cannot recommend. Very disappointed

No night vision and terrible sound.. I was really hoping I’d love this monitor but I don’t. The wide angle is great and when the lights are on in the room, the picture is beautiful. But when the lights are off we cannot see anything and I can only hear noises if the volume is all the way up. I really want to return this product but I don’t see an option to do so

Picture Excellent, Connectivity Sucks. First, the picture quality is excellent for a non-WiFi camera.

Picture quality aside, this camera sucked. I really wanted to like it and keep it b/c picture was so clear but I just couldn’t justify keeing it for picture alone.

Connectivity was awful. I live in a very small, open-concept home and the connection was disconnecting from monitor in THE SAME ROOM. Connection bars constantly blinked on/off no matter how close/far from camera unit. Plus, BIG downside here, every time we’d put it into standby/vox/audio mode, when we’d turn screen back on it ALWAYS took 15-30 seconds to locate & reconnect to camera!

Because of the connection issues we didn’t even bother leaving it on all night for fear of it being disconnected and not hearing our little one.

Monitor unit felt solid/well-made and was a perfect size. User interface/button setup was easy enough. Viewing range of camera was great (we need whole room visibility so this was one reason we tried this unit).

Have used this in comparison to 2 Dragon Touch options (DT50 and the one with antlers) and our original Infant Optics dx-8 (which we are keeping for now as it’s range is FAR superior to others we’ve tried and the reliability has been more consistent)

GREAT OVERPRICED MONITOR. I need a 4 camera system. I bought this monitor and one extra camera to try out, with the intention of buying 2 extra cameras if I liked the system. This system is quite a bit more expensive than other monitor systems, especially if you are going to max out the camera capacity. My main reason for ultimately breaking down and trying this one is because many other systems with good ratings did not have their extra cameras available for sale.

I like the monitor and cameras overall. The picture is great, the controls are great, the UI is pretty intuitive. My one complaint about the system itself is that you cannot show all the cameras on screen at one time, a feature that WAS on my need to have list.

One day after setting up this monitor, I went to purchase the 2 additional cameras that I need. A few minutes after placing them in my cart, the price changed from $80 to $100 APIECE. $80 was already high, but I was willing to do l pay it because I like this system. I CAN NOT afford a 25% increase, and no one should expect to pay $100 EACH for extra cameras.

I like this monitor so much I'm willing to forego that one feature that I originally very much wanted to have. But ONLY if the extra camera returns to the original price. Otherwise, I will have to return the system and continue my search for a monitor whose extra cameras aren't outrageously (and greedily) priced
Horrible Quality for the Price. There is no way the photo is 1080p, the sounds is so staticky/ muffled, and the moon light is awful. Terrible all around. Very disappointed

Great camera with a couple flaws. This is an upgrade from a smaller, cheaper baby monitor that I have been using for the last year and a half. Going from the $50 Babysense that I have been using, it’s a big improvement. It’s a much larger screen with better video quality, you can move the camera using the monitor, you can zoom in on baby, and you can set a movement box to alert you if baby moves out of it. All of these are features I did not have with my other monitor and are definitely much nicer. It easily mounts on the wall and I can move the camera to see her whole room while she is playing, both cameras play music or white noise but I don’t use those settings because I don’t want to draw her attention to the cameras. They both have a small light that’s not very noticeable when on. I do like that this camera has a very long cord making it much easier to place it in a convenient spot vs the Babysense I was limited on how far from the outlet I could go. The box even came with little command type strips to help run the cord away from baby’s reach.

However, this camera does not have a way to turn off the video without turning off the sound when plugged in like my other one does. I don’t like having the bright screen on when I sleep but obviously want the sound on to hear if she wakes. The screen does automatically go to sleep after a couple of minutes when unplugged but I don’t like that I can’t choose to have it stay on instead because if it’s unplugged I usually have it near me while she naps and want to be able to just glance at it to see how she’s doing. The battery life when it’s unplugged is about 4 hours. In order to turn it on and off you have to hold the power button for a good while. The microphone picks up noise well, almost too well, if I have her door open I can hear all the noises down the hall echoing through the monitor even on the quietest setting. I tried using the voice once and she was terrified of the camera the rest of the night because it’s louder than her other camera.

I think it’s a great camera but I don’t think the price reflects the technology used either. I think that if it were closer to the $130 mark it would be more worth it.

Update: the more I use the monitor the less I like it and now the battery life when unplugged barely lasts 2 hours, and rarely for an entire nap. It’s frustrating and I wouldn’t recommend it
Horrible picture. Picture is terrible. Would not recommend to buy. Liked the fact you could add camera to the system but would rather pay more for better quality

Why the hell is the light on the same button as the “on” button?!. My headline says it all, but why in the world would someone design a monitor with the “on” switch and the “light” switch on the same button?! This was not designed for parents who enjoy their child staying asleep

NOT a reliable baby monitor!. We needed a monitor that allowed a split-screen in order to monitor kids in 2 different rooms. We tried this brand after using a Motorola monitor for 3 years that worked well, however, decided to switch brands once our twins were born (Motorola changed their monitors and the quality suffered).

3. The other worrisome issue is that there is a SIGNIFICANT time delay on the monitor. I’ve gone in to check on my child. When I return to the monitor about 1.5 mins passes by when I’ll finally see myself on the monitor. So many things can happen in 1.5 mins. This is just unacceptable.

4. Now, the parent monitor has stopped charged with the power cord. I’ve tried different power cords to no avail, so the issue is with the parent monitor itself.

I am Extremely dissatisfied with this product.

I DO NOT recommend this product!
You could probably get a cheaper model that has really good quality video for less.. The music and story features on this are terrible. The speaker sounds like it's been submerged underwater

No “sleep” mode for sound. We were gifted this monitor for baby #2. We had a Samsung monitor for the first baby but it broke when he became a toddler and played with it. So we tried a new brand this time. Big mistake. This monitor is subpar for two main reasons:
